# Contexts that must be required by the branch protection on main. One per line.
# Nothing is required today: the only rulesets applying here are enterprise-sourced and carry no
# required_status_checks rule, so every gate below reports and blocks nothing. Creating a repository ruleset
# is an org-owner action, and this file is what it should be created from. required-checks-drift compares
# the two and stays warn-only until it exists.
# These strings are stable only because every gate instance carries an explicit `name:` in config.yml:
# CircleCI otherwise appends unpredictable suffixes (dependency-cve-scan once reported as -1).
# Confirm with `gh pr checks` after any topology change.

# Dependency CVEs in Cargo.lock, fixable CRITICAL/HIGH, waivers subtracted at gate time
ci/circleci: dependency-cve-scan

# SAST tier 1: full repo, p/default plus p/rust, ERROR band
ci/circleci: sast-scan

# SAST tier 2: newly introduced findings only, WARNING band
ci/circleci: sast-scan-diff

# Waiver and disposition integrity, plus any shrinkage of SAST scope
ci/circleci: disposition-check

# Existing functional gates, so the ruleset gets created complete rather than security-only
ci/circleci: lint-python
ci/circleci: lint-rust
ci/circleci: test-rust
ci/circleci: test-python-310-single-3.12
ci/circleci: test-python-310-cluster-3.12
ci/circleci: test-python-313-single-3.12
ci/circleci: test-python-313-cluster-3.12

# Not required yet, deliberately:
#   ci/circleci: secret-scan
#     Report-only for one enumeration cycle so genuine fixtures get dated allow-rules before the gate can
#     go red. Add this line in the same change that sets fail-on-findings: true.
#   ci/circleci: dockerfile-scan
#     Misconfig half is report-only until DS-0015 and DS-0029 are fixed; the credential guard already blocks.
#   ci/circleci: required-checks-drift
#     Warn-only by construction, so requiring it adds no protection.
